http_endpoint.description: Full HTTP(S) URL of the remote logging endpoint.

http_method.description: HTTP method used for sending logs (typically POST).

http_headers.description: List of HTTP headers to attach to each request. Each item has a key-value pair.

queue_size.description: Maximum number of queued log messages before dropping new ones. Set to 0 for unlimited (not recommended in production).

batch_size.description: Maximum number of messages bundled in a single HTTP POST request.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for HTTP response before timing out.

retry_attempts.description: Number of retry attempts on HTTP failure before discarding the message batch.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate of the HTTPS endpoint.

cert_file.description: Optional path to client certificate file for TLS mutual authentication (absolute or relative to ejabberd config dir).

keyfile.description: Optional path to client private key file for TLS mutual authentication.
